title: Samurai removal 4 of 7: the Second Brain panel and the health checker are gone
story: The Second Brain panel is gone, with the Samurai audit stream, the ops journal, 'Harvest now', old harvest reports and the files list, its brain icon and its Features switch. The health checker that counted large Samurai files is gone too, with its badge and 'Health — Second Brain' toasts, so Settings → Notifications covers GitHub toasts only. Parking, PR review launches and the Work Journal are unchanged.

checks.criterion: No Second Brain icon or panel
checks.steps: Start Maestro fresh and look at the icon strip on the far left.

checks.criterion: A layout saved with Second Brain open loads
checks.steps: In a test profile set localStorage 'maestro-panel-strip' to {"state":{"openPanels":["secondbrain","notes"],"widths":{}},"version":0}, then restart.
checks.expected: Only the Notes panel open, no error.

checks.criterion: No health badge or toast; GitHub toasts still work
checks.steps: Leave the app open 15 minutes; then toggle Settings → Notifications → Show notifications off and on.
checks.expected: No 'Health — …' toast, no orange count on any strip icon; GitHub toasts still work.

checks.criterion: Launching a PR review still works
checks.steps: Git panel → PR monitor → a PR row's ⋮ menu → tick a step → launch.
checks.expected: A new Claude terminal opens and receives the review prompt.
